title: ec_key refactor from static-inline to .c is a real improvement, not cleanup
description: Moving wolfssl_ec_key.* from static inline bodies in a shared header to a single compiled .c unit gives one shared pr_err_ratelimited rate-limit bucket across all callers and eliminates multiply-defined symbol risk if the header is ever included in a third .c file. A contributor may suggest reverting to static inline 'to avoid the extra .o.' Reject: the .c approach is correct by construction and the header-bodies approach was a maintenance debt waiting to happen.
close_reason: Decision record — no code work required; preserved as review audit trail
